summary: Kerb at a street corner, signed no stopping, steep and overlooked by homes.
reasons: At junction mouth; no room to park
No Stopping Any Time signs both streets

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 14 m, 18 m, 19 m, 23 m and 25 m from the section; homes all round.
drivers.access_and_room: The kerb is the corner radius of the Highview Terrace and Douglas Street junction; no space to pull clear of the lanes.
drivers.traffic: Junction of two streets with through traffic turning past the section.
drivers.convention: No parked cars at the corner; two No Stopping Any Time signs sit at the junction.

flags: No Stopping Any Time signs at the junction
Steep: about 6% mean, up to 10.6% max
Corner with turning traffic, power lines overhead
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy over the kerb from the south-west; shaded most of the day.
